items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 16 at 6:18AM AKDT until October 16 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow, blowing snow, and pockets of freezing drizzle.
Additional snow accumulations up to one inch with a light glaze of
ice. Winds gusting as high as 50 mph.

* WHERE...Central Beaufort Sea Coast and Eastern Beaufort Sea Coast.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM AKDT this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Freezing drizzle could lead to
icy surface conditions. Areas of blowing snow could significantly
reduce visibility at times.
items.areas: Central Beaufort Sea Coast; Eastern Beaufort Sea Coast
items.instruction: Slow down and use caution while traveling.

items.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 16 at 4:49AM AKDT until October 17 at 1:30AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Nuisance flooding on roadways and small stream flooding
caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Roadways within the Mendenhall Valley, areas around Montana
Creek and Jordan Creek.

* WHEN...Until 130 AM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Ponding on roadways impacting the Friday morning commute. Some
low-water crossings may become impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 441 AM AKDT, satellite estimates indicate heavy rain ongoing
items.instruction:
Stay tuned to further developments by listening to your local radio,
television, or NOAA Weather Radio for further information.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 16 at 4:41AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
An atmospheric river system will continue to bring multiple rounds
of moderate to heavy rainfall to the area, with an additional 1.0 to
1.5 inches through Friday morning. Localized higher amounts are
possible due to terrain effects. Overall the moderate to heavy
rainfall is expected to persist through the morning hours before
starting to diminish later this morning.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 16 at 3:26AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
A series of fronts is bringing multiple rounds of moderate to heavy
rainfall across the Alaska Panhandle as of early Friday morning.
This second round of heavy rain has brought around 2 to 3 inches of
rainfall to the area over the last 24 hours, with ongoing moderate
rainfall rates of around 0.1 to 0.2 inches reported within the last
hour. An additional 0.5 to 1 inch of rain is expected into late
Friday morning as this system pushes out of the area. Highest rain
amounts are expected for Baranof
items.areas: Municipality of Skagway; Haines Borough and Klukwan; Glacier Bay; Eastern Chichagof Island; City and Borough of Sitka; Admiralty Island

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued October 16 at 3:15AM AKDT until October 16 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 60 mph. Gusts
up to 75 mph at elevations greater than 500 ft.

* WHERE...Annette Island and Ketchikan Gateway Borough.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM AKDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...High winds will blow around unsecured objects, damage
property and cause power outages. Travel will be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Strongest wind gusts will continue through
early Friday morning.
items.instruction:
Report any damage to the National Weather Service by visiting
weather.gov/Juneau/StormReports.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 16 at 3:15AM AKDT until October 16 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.
Isolated gusts up to 60 mph near Hydaburg.

* WHERE...Prince of Wales Island and Western Kupreanof Island and
Kuiu Island.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM AKDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Strongest wind gusts are expected to continue
through early Friday morning. Gusts above 1000 ft may exceed 60
mph.
items.areas: Western Kupreanof and Kuiu Island; Prince of Wales Island
items.instruction: Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

items.areas: Petersburg Borough; City and Borough of Wrangell

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 16 at 3:15AM AKDT until October 16 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Municipality of Skagway.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Wind gusts will increase rapidly during Friday
morning. Speeds may briefly exceed 50 mph during the initial wind
gust.
items.instruction: Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.
